how_to_apply: Register on the KVS contractual teachers portal: Samvida Sathi registration page.
Download the Bio-Data cum Application form for Part-Time/Contractual Teacher 2026-27 from the KV SSB Palia Kalan website (it is also attached to the notice).

Fill in every part of the form: the post applied for, your personal details, category (General/SC/ST/OBC/PH), Aadhaar and PAN numbers, your academic marks from Class XII onwards, professional qualifications (B.Ed., D.El.Ed./D.Ed./BTC, RCI CRR No. for Special Education), teaching experience, CTET status, computer knowledge and languages known. Affix your latest photograph and sign the declaration.
Report to the Vidyalaya at 08:00 AM on 3 November 2026 with the form and your documents.

Affix your latest photograph and sign the declaration. Report to the Vidyalaya at 08:00 AM on 3 November 2026 with the form and your documents. faq.question: Q1. What minimum marks do I need for PGT (English)?
faq.answer: You need at least 50% marks in your Master Degree in English (or Integrated Post Graduate Course), and at least 50% in your B.Ed. or integrated B.Ed. qualification.

faq.question: Q2. Do I have to register online before the interview?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice asks candidates to apply through https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/register before they attend the interview.

faq.question: Q3. What time should I reach the school?
Q4. Where is the interview held?
faq.answer: At Kendriya Vidyalaya, 39th Battalion Sashastra Seema Bal, Gadania, Palia Kalan, Lakhimpur Kheri, PIN-262902.

faq.question: Q5. Will I get travel allowance for attending?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary appointment on contract for the session 2026-27, under Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan rules.

faq.question: Q7. Must I be able to teach in both Hindi and English?
faq.answer: Yes. Proficiency to teach in Hindi and English medium is part of the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can I contact for more information?
faq.answer: You can call the Vidyalaya on 8171016307 or email [email protected].
